name: Web runtime typechecks
command: export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"; (cd packages/client-runtime && tsc --noEmit); runtime_status=$?; (cd apps/web && tsc --noEmit); web_status=$?; echo "RUNTIME_EXIT=$runtime_status WEB_EXIT=$web_status"; test "$runtime_status" = 0 && test "$web_status" = 0
